objective: Measure whether routing v2 delegates seven repository-discovery categories without losing local-task precision, then check one representative complete task for quality, cost, latency, citation validity, and timeout reliability.

arms.baseline: The routing policy at source_head, with fast Scout held constant.
arms.candidate: Routing v2, with fast Scout held constant.

broad_categories: exported configuration and API blast radius
routing_lane.stop_condition: Stop after the first repository operation completes; this lane measures route choice, not patch quality.
outcomes: Scout recall across each broad category

complete_task_lane.limitation: Not run because the candidate failed the predeclared routing gate. A complete-task pair cannot rescue deterministic over-routing of the local control.

billing.parent: Exact codex-lb request-log totals for each parent conversation.
billing.scout: Per-call usage returned by RepoTracer and the production Luna subscription price schedule.
billing.complete: Parent cost plus every Scout call.

decision_gates.routing: Candidate must route all 21 broad repeats to Scout and all 21 local repeats locally.
decision_gates.quality: Candidate complete-task verifier outcome may not regress.
decision_gates.citations: Every citation returned by successful Scout calls must resolve to an existing source range.
decision_gates.reliability: No candidate timeout; the inactivity behavior checks must pass.
decision_gates.economics: Report cost and latency without claiming a stable complete-task effect from one pair.

invalidated_attempts.reason: The harness escaped digit classes in its derived citation-count regex. Route rows remain preserved, but the attempt was cancelled and excluded before a summary was produced.

failure_policy.infrastructure: Preserve the failed attempt and rerun its matched pair.
failure_policy.model: Timeout, nonzero exit, wrong route, malformed output, bad citation, or verifier failure remains scored.
failure_policy.retention: Keep raw trajectories and private artifacts ignored. Never rewrite a completed valid trial.
